files_summary.commits.json: Array of commit objects representing the full commit history of the repository. Each object includes the commit hash, author name, author email, date, and commit message.
files_summary.branches.json: Array of branch objects describing all branches in the repository. Each object contains the branch name, a boolean indicating if it is the current branch, the latest commit hash on that branch, and the commit message of that latest commit.
files_summary.tags.json: Array of tag objects for repository tags. Each object provides the tag name, the associated commit hash, the tag message, and the date the tag was created.
files_summary.repo_structure.json: JSON representation of the repository's file tree. It includes the repository root path and a list of files with their relative paths, file types (e.g., markdown, python, text), and a brief description of each file's purpose.
files_summary.users.json:
JSON array of 10 user objects. Each object contains:
- user_id (e.g., "U0001")
- username (e.g., "user1")
- email (e.g., "user1@example.com")
- entity (always "example-team")
- created_at (ISO‑8601 timestamp).
files_summary.projects.json:
JSON array of 5 project objects for the entity "example-team". Each object includes:
- name (project slug, e.g., "image-classification")
- entity
- description
- visibility ("public" or "private")
- created_at / updated_at (ISO timestamps)
- tags (list of 3 descriptive tags).
files_summary.runs.csv:
CSV file with 100 synthetic run records (plus header). Columns:
- run_id (8‑character alphanumeric ID)
- project_name (one of the 5 projects)
- display_name (human‑readable name, e.g., "image-classification_run_3")
- state ("finished", "running" or "failed")
- created_at (ISO timestamp)
- accuracy (float, 0.6‑0.99)
- loss (float, 0.1‑2.0)
- learning_rate (float, e.g., 0.0001)
- batch_size (16/32/64/128)
- epochs (5/10/20/50)
- user_id (links to a user in users.json).
files_summary.artifacts.json:
JSON array of 50 artifact entries (10 per project). Each artifact includes:
- artifact_id (unique ID)
- project_name
- name (e.g., "image-classification_artifact_7")
- version (e.g., "v3")
- digest (UUID hex string)
- size_bytes (1 MiB – 1 GiB)
- created_at (ISO timestamp)
- metadata object with fields:
  • framework ("torch", "tensorflow" or "jax")
  • model_type (e.g., "resnet", "bert", "gpt", "dqn", "vae")
  • description (text describing the artifact).
files_summary.traces.json:
JSON array of 227 Weave trace objects (roots + children). Each trace record contains:
- id (unique sequential ID like "T000001")
- trace_id (UUID shared among related traces)
- parent_id (null for root traces; otherwise points to the parent trace id)
- project_name (one of the 5 projects)
- op_name (URI style string, e.g., "weave:///root_op_4")
- display_name (readable label)
- started_at / ended_at (ISO timestamps)
- status ("success" or "error")
- latency_ms (integer)
- costs object with:
  • prompt_tokens_total_cost (float)
  • completion_tokens_total_cost (float)
  • total_cost (sum of the two)
- attributes object with:
  • model_name (e.g., "gpt-4")
  • token_count (integer).
The traces reflect a realistic parent‑child hierarchy (15 root traces per project, each with 1‑3 child traces).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_commits
tool_schemas.description: Lists commit records from the repository history and returns up to the requested limit, optionally filtered by author name and a since/until date-time window. It refuses requests with a non-integer or non-positive limit, or with since/until values that are not valid date-times. It also refuses a date range where since is later than until because the filter window is contradictory.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

author.description: Filter commits by the author's name.

tool_schemas.name: get_commit
tool_schemas.description: Returns the commit record matching the provided commit hash. It refuses requests that omit commit_hash or provide an empty value, because a commit cannot be identified without it. It also refuses commit_hash values that don’t match any known commit in the repository history.

commit_hash.description: The SHA hash of the commit to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_branches
tool_schemas.description: Lists branch records and returns them all, or only the current branch when current_only is true, and can further filter results by a name substring. It refuses requests where current_only is not a boolean or name_filter is not a string. It also refuses requests for the current branch when no current branch is available to report.

current_only.description: If true, only return the currently checked-out branch.

name_filter.description: Return only branches whose name contains this substring.

tool_schemas.name: get_branch
tool_schemas.description: Returns the branch record for the exact branch_name provided. It refuses requests that omit branch_name or provide an empty value, because an exact name is required. It also refuses branch_name values that don’t match an existing branch.

branch_name.description: The exact name of the branch to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: List tag objects, optionally filtering by name and limiting the number of results.

name_filter.description: Return only tags whose name contains this substring.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_tag
tool_schemas.description: Returns the tag record for the exact tag_name provided. It refuses requests that omit tag_name or provide an empty value, because an exact name is required. It also refuses tag_name values that don’t match an existing tag.

tag_name.description: The exact name of the tag to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_repo_structure
tool_schemas.description: Returns the repository’s file tree structure, optionally narrowed to entries whose relative path contains the provided path_filter substring. It refuses requests where path_filter is present but not a string. It also refuses requests when the repository structure metadata is unavailable to browse.

path_filter.description: Only include files whose relative_path contains this substring.

tool_schemas.name: find_file
tool_schemas.description: Finds a file by its relative path and returns that file’s structure metadata. It refuses requests that omit file_path or provide an empty value, because the lookup key is missing. It also refuses requests where no file exists at the specified relative path in the repository structure.

file_path.description: The relative path of the file to locate.

tool_schemas.name: list_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists user records and returns a paginated result set, optionally filtered by exact username, entity, and a created_at date-time range, and optionally sorted. It refuses requests with an invalid cursor, a non-integer or non-positive limit, unsupported sort_by/sort_order values, or created_since/created_until values that are not valid date-times. It also refuses contradictory date ranges where created_since is later than created_until.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue listing users from a previous response.

created_since.description: Include users created at or after this timestamp.

created_until.description: Include users created at or before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user record identified by user_id. It refuses requests that omit user_id or provide an empty value, because the user cannot be identified without it. It also refuses user_id values that don’t correspond to an existing user.

user_id.description: The identifier of the user, e.g., "U0001".

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists project records and returns a paginated result set, optionally filtered by exact name, entity, visibility, tag, created/updated date-time windows, and optionally sorted. It refuses requests with an invalid cursor, a non-integer or non-positive limit, unsupported visibility/name/sort_by/sort_order values, or any created/updated since/until values that are not valid date-times. It also refuses contradictory time windows where a since value is later than its corresponding until value.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue listing projects from a previous response.

name.description: Filter projects by exact project name.

entity.description: Filter projects by owning entity/organization name.

tag.description: Filter projects to those containing this tag.

created_since.description: Include projects created at or after this timestamp.

created_until.description: Include projects created at or before this timestamp.

updated_since.description: Include projects updated at or after this timestamp.

updated_until.description: Include projects updated at or before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Returns the project identified by `project_name`, including its stored metadata and identifiers. Refuses requests that omit `project_name` or provide a blank/invalid slug, and refuses when no project exists with that name. If the caller is not allowed to view the project, the request is refused due to insufficient access.

project_name.description: The slug/name of the project, e.g., "image-classification".

tool_schemas.name: list_runs
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of run records, optionally filtered by project, state, user, metric ranges, and training configuration fields. Refuses requests with invalid filter values (for example, unknown `state`, non-numeric metric bounds, or non-integer `batch_size`/`epochs`) and refuses conflicting ranges where a provided minimum exceeds its corresponding maximum. If `project_name` is provided but does not identify a project the caller can access, the request is refused.

project_name.description: Filter runs belonging to a specific project.

user_id.description: Filter by the user who launched the run.

min_accuracy.description: Include runs with accuracy greater than or equal to this value.

max_accuracy.description: Include runs with accuracy less than or equal to this value.

min_loss.description: Include runs with loss greater than or equal to this value.

max_loss.description: Include runs with loss less than or equal to this value.

batch_size.description: Filter runs that used a specific batch size.

epochs.description: Filter runs that were trained for a specific number of epochs.

tool_schemas.name: get_run
tool_schemas.description: Returns the single run record identified by `run_id`. Refuses requests that omit `run_id`, provide an ID that is not a valid 8-character alphanumeric run identifier, or reference a run that does not exist. If the run belongs to a project the caller cannot access, the request is refused.

run_id.description: The 8‑character alphanumeric ID of the run.

tool_schemas.name: list_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of artifact entries, optionally filtered by `project_name`, `framework`, and `model_type`. Refuses requests with an unsupported `framework` value or invalid/blank filter strings. If `project_name` is provided but the project does not exist or is not visible to the caller, the request is refused.

project_name.description: Filter artifacts belonging to a specific project.

framework.description: Filter by the ML framework used.

tool_schemas.name: get_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Returns the artifact entry identified by `artifact_id`. Refuses requests that omit `artifact_id`, provide a blank/invalid identifier, or reference an artifact that does not exist. If the artifact belongs to a project the caller cannot access, the request is refused.

artifact_id.description: The unique identifier of the artifact.

tool_schemas.name: list_traces
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of trace records, optionally filtered by project, status, parent trace, and an operation-name substring match. Refuses requests with an unsupported `status` value, invalid/blank IDs, or an invalid `op_name_contains` filter. If `project_name` is provided but the project does not exist or is not visible to the caller, the request is refused.

project_name.description: Filter traces belonging to a specific project.

parent_id.description: Return only child traces of the given parent trace ID.

op_name_contains.description: Return traces whose `op_name` contains this substring.

tool_schemas.name: get_trace
tool_schemas.description: Returns the trace record identified by `trace_id`. Refuses requests that omit `trace_id`, provide a value that is not a valid UUID, or reference a trace that does not exist. If the trace belongs to a project the caller cannot access, the request is refused.

trace_id.description: The UUID identifying the trace (shared among related spans).

metadata.name: TraceForge Records Hub
metadata.description: A backend service that lets users browse projects, users, runs, artifacts, and trace records alongside lightweight repository metadata like commits, branches, tags, file lookup, and repository structure.
